translations.web: Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!
translations.bsb: Set plans by consultation, and wage war under sound guidance.
translations.kjv: Every purpose is established by counsel: and with good advice make war.
translations.asv: Every purpose is established by counsel; And by wise guidance make thou war.
